_comment: English body for prompt-case-report-outline. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output an outline and required evidence per section; do not fill unsupported content.
Inputs: Report goal, audience, and available material list.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Create an outline for report {goal}. Output sections[] with title, question, evidence_needed and source_candidate. evidence_needed names checkable material types; source_candidate must come from {materials}, mark gaps when missing. Do not write body conclusions.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.预期输出形态: sections[] with questions, evidence needs and material gaps.
sections.检查点:
- Each section has checkable evidence_needed.
- source_candidate stays within the material list.
- Gaps are explicitly listed.
sections.失败分支:
- Outline becomes conclusions: replace assertions with questions.
- Insufficient materials: mark gaps, do not invent sources.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
